generations.exact_prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: fixed 2D cartoon character avatar for Spheres, portrait aspect ratio 2:3, 1024 x 1536 RGB.
Create one original, respectful full-body cartoon of Mikhail Gorbachev, exact person mikhail_gorbachev, as an artistic interpretation of his appearance from January to late December 1991.
Image 1 is the approved Margaret Thatcher GAME STYLE reference only (STYLE ONLY): match its confident dark outlines, simplified expressive face, graphic cel shading, slightly enlarged head and approximately 5.5-head adult proportions, compact full-body framing and quiet opaque dark teal backdrop. Do not copy her identity, face, hairstyle, handbag, clothing or pose.
Image 2 is the exact-person likeness reference: Leo Medvedev's (Lev Leonidovich Medvedev) CC BY-SA 4.0 black-and-white head-and-shoulders photograph of Mikhail Gorbachev in Moscow in October 1991 (the uploader gives the month; a later unsourced edit added the day 24), inside this appearance window. Preserve his recognizable face: broad rounded face with full cheeks, soft jowls and a rounded chin; high domed forehead running into a bald crown; short smooth gray-white hair only at the sides and back, combed back over and behind fairly large ears; his distinctive irregular birthmark must follow the actual broad shape in Image 2: a wide broken arch extending laterally from HIS RIGHT front crown, the viewer’s LEFT scalp above his right temple, across the upper bald crown toward the central upper forehead, with a substantial irregular downward lobe at the arch’s central-forehead end. The mark spans a broad area of the upper right scalp and crown; it is not a thin vertical stripe or a row of centered dots. Preserve the few smaller detached flecks separately on HIS RIGHT forehead above his right eyebrow, displaced toward the viewer’s LEFT of the main downward lobe. Follow the source’s position, width, asymmetry and curved contour faithfully, not a mirrored or centered symbolic mark. Render it as flat muted reddish-plum pigmentation with organic uneven edges, naturally integrated into the skin and never exaggerated or mocked; thick dark straight-to-slightly-arched brows, much darker than his hair; dark slightly deep-set eyes with soft bags beneath; broad nose with a rounded fleshy tip; thin closed lips with faint lines from nose to mouth; clean shaven; no glasses, as in this photograph. The photograph lies about nine to ten months after this appearance begins and two to three months before it ends, so no age adjustment is needed: show a man of 59 to 60 (he turns 60 on 2 March 1991), dignified and vigorous, without mocking exaggeration. His expression is calm, serious and attentive, mouth closed, head in a slight three-quarter turn as in the photograph.
Clothing: dark charcoal-gray civilian two-piece suit with very fine pinstripes, plain white shirt with a pointed collar, dark burgundy tie with a few thin lighter diagonal stripes, black shoes. Image 2 is black and white, so every color in the card is an artistic choice that follows its tones: light, slightly ruddy complexion, gray-white hair, and a muted reddish-plum tone for the birthmark. The standing body, hands, trousers and shoes are artistic extensions of a head-and-shoulders photograph. Average height with a solid, stocky build. No medals, sash, lapel pin, badge, flag or invented insignia.
Composition: exactly one man centered standing in a relaxed slight three-quarter pose, head to both shoes fully visible with comfortable margins; both hands visible, one relaxed open beside his hip and the other lightly resting near his jacket button. Face, birthmark and silhouette should read clearly at 106 x 152 pixels.
Background: intentionally opaque flat dark teal #192D34 with only a very subtle tonal gradient, matching Image 1; do not copy the plain dark gray backdrop of the photograph; no setting, furniture or other people.
Style constraints: clearly drawn 2D cartoon in full natural color (not black and white, grayscale or sepia) with crisp silhouettes and restrained cel shading, no photographic skin texture, no realistic painterly miniature, no 3D render, no giant chibi head. No text, letters, captions, borders, watermark, flags, insignia, hammer and sickle, red star, extra people, podium, microphone, documents, weapon or checkerboard. Generate the complete finished card, not a mockup.
